catalogue.name: Purchase.Order.Pdf
catalogue.description: Prints a purchase order as a PDF document and writes an interaction log entry when an interaction template is set up.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Get an open purchase order as a PDF, printed with the vendor's report selection for usage P.Order. Increases the order's No. Printed and, when an interaction template is set up, writes an interaction log entry. For a sales order confirmation use Sales.OrderConfirmation.Pdf; for any other report use Orchestrator.Report.SaveAs.

effect.changes: Increases No. Printed on the purchase order and, when an interaction template is set up for purchase orders, writes an interaction log entry for the vendor's contact: the standard report does both. It may also archive a version of the order when Purchases & Payables Setup archives orders. A replacement report in Report Selections may not. Saving the PDF commits the work done so far, so the call cannot run inside a larger transaction that is rolled back.

chapters.overview: Returns an open purchase order as a PDF, printed with the report the vendor's Report Selection (usage P.Order) names; by default the standard purchase order. Use it to hand the order to the vendor, a person or another system. Printing it increases No. Printed on the order and, when an interaction template is set up for purchase orders, writes an interaction log entry.
chapters.notes: subject and the keys under data (orderNo, orderId, documentNo, documentId) are all tried: a value that looks like a GUID is read as the SystemId, anything else as the No. Only purchase documents of type Order are found. Two identifiers that name different orders are refused with ConflictingIdentifiers. The success MIME type carries name="PurchaseOrder-<SystemId>.pdf"; callers may use that filename when saving the unchanged binary PDF. Only the Success answer is a PDF; an error answer is JSON (text/json). The same read permission on Purchase Header is required as for reading the order. Saving the PDF commits the work done so far, so the call cannot run inside a larger transaction that is rolled back. When an interaction template is set up for purchase orders, the standard report writes an interaction log entry for the vendor's contact. A replacement report in Report Selections may not. The call does not change whether that logging happens.

catalogue.description: Prentar innkaupapöntun sem PDF-skjal og skrifar færslu í samskiptaskrá þegar samskiptasniðmát er skilgreint.
catalogue.selectionDescription: Sækja opna innkaupapöntun sem PDF, prentaða með skýrsluvali lánardrottins fyrir notkunina P.Order. Hækkar prentteljara pöntunarinnar og, þegar samskiptasniðmát er skilgreint, skrifar færslu í samskiptaskrá. Fyrir pöntunarstaðfestingu sölupöntunar notaðu Sales.OrderConfirmation.Pdf; fyrir aðrar skýrslur notaðu Orchestrator.Report.SaveAs.
